dedupe_keys.name: land suitability map for solar photovoltaic pv installations in ukraine at 100 m resolution

description: Land Suitability Map for Solar Photovoltaic (PV) Installations in Ukraine at 100 m resolution is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Sofiia Drozd, Andrii Shelestov (Space Research Institute). This dataset provides a high-resolution (100 m) raster map of land suitability for the installation of solar photovoltaic (PV) power plants across the entire territory of Ukraine with values ranging from 0 (unsuitable) to 1 (highly suitable). Coverage: national (UA); the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
